summary: Tenon Medical filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending its at-the-market offering program, increasing the amount sellable under General Instruction I.B.6 to up to $7,176,045 of common stock, beyond the $2,809,378 already sold in the trailing twelve months. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acts as sales agent under the August 11, 2026 sales agreement. The filing references a $29,956,270 non-affiliate float based on 2,625,440 shares at $11.41, and notes TNON last closed at $2.91 on October 15, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown increase, not a special situation.
